description: On 0.28.0, `muster canvas open red.png --pane <pane>` splits at once (the CLI returns in 0.02 s), but the pane stays black for a noticeable moment before the image draws, from a shell as well. Likely the web view starting or loading after the pane is placed; drawing the pane's background in the canvas theme, or placing the pane once the document is ready, would hide it. From tooling feedback a_32HZ2rDHg.
title: A new canvas pane shows black for a moment before its image
